name: wechat-local-reader
description: Turn a WeChat Official Account article link into a local Markdown document that agents can summarize, analyze, archive, or use for downstream tasks.
value_proposition: Drop a mp.weixin.qq.com article link into Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, or another agent; the skill reads it locally through Chrome/Edge CDP and saves clean article content as Markdown.

inputs.url: WeChat Official Account article URL from mp.weixin.qq.com

outputs.stdout: JSON status including ok, outputPath, title, author, published, and chars
